answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 7 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the ripple release is recorded with every signature, the voyage audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the horizon graph and each risks its bond. That is 2 dollars per alias.
